path_disposition_rule.PARSE_INCLUDED: every other blob enumerated by the immutable recursive tree, including top-level research documents, audits/**/*.md, audits/**/*.py, audits/**/*.json, experiments/**/*.md, experiments/**/*.py, and experiments/**/*.json

coverage_semantics: The immutable recursive tree is the exact exhaustive path ledger. Every blob is disposed by the rule above; no path may be silently ignored. Research-bearing semantic parsing is aperture-relative to this frozen tree.

execution_provenance.interpretation: No GitHub Actions run was retrieved for the frozen HEAD. This does not erase source-local execution-provenance records stored in the tree and does not prove no historical execution occurred.

standing_boundaries: planned test != preregistration != implementation != execution provenance != persisted result != audit interpretation != consolidation
later consolidation != retroactive strengthening of earlier result
source-reported relation != endpoint identity != Cerebro edge
absence_rule: not extracted != does not exist outside the frozen aperture
